responsibility: Declares the Solaris-specific driver and target options consumed by GCC’s generated option machinery. It introduces Solaris command-line switches such as -G, -YP, -Ym, -pthread/-pthreads, -rdynamic, and the Solaris target options -mclear-hwcap and -mimpure-text, providing the option metadata that Solaris specs and hooks rely on rather than implementing their behavior directly.
same_name_distinction: This is the declarative Solaris option table for switches like -G, -YP, -Ym, -pthread/-pthreads, -rdynamic, and Solaris-specific -m* options; unlike gcc/config/sol2.h and gcc/config/sol2.cc, it does not implement Solaris specs or backend helper logic.
